Earnings.name: Earnings
Earnings.when: The symbol's own earnings report day.

ExDividend.name: Ex-dividend
ExDividend.when: The symbol's own ex-dividend day. A short call can be assigned the day before.

FOMC.name: Fed decision (FOMC)
FOMC.when: The Federal Reserve's rate decision, 2:00 PM ET, eight times a year.

FirstWeekly.name: First weekly expiry
FirstWeekly.when: The first Friday of the month (the Thursday when it is a holiday).

FuturesRoll.name: Futures roll
FuturesRoll.when: The Thursday a week before triple witching, when index futures roll to the next quarter.

MonthEnd.name: Month end
MonthEnd.when: The last trading day of the month.

NFP.name: Jobs report (NFP)
NFP.when: The monthly employment report, 8:30 AM ET, usually the first Friday.

OPEX.name: Monthly options expiry (OPEX)
OPEX.when: The third Friday of the month (the Thursday when it is a holiday).

PCE.name: PCE inflation
PCE.when: The Fed's preferred inflation measure, 8:30 AM ET, near the end of the month.

PMI-Mfg.name: Manufacturing PMI
PMI-Mfg.when: The ISM manufacturing survey, 10:00 AM ET, the 1st trading day of the month.

PMI-Svcs.name: Services PMI
PMI-Svcs.when: The ISM services survey, 10:00 AM ET, the 3rd trading day of the month.

QuarterEnd.name: Quarter end
QuarterEnd.when: The last trading day of March, June, September and December.

TripleWitching.name: Triple witching
TripleWitching.when: The third Friday of March, June, September and December: stock options, index options and index futures expire together.

VIXExpiry.name: VIX expiry
VIXExpiry.when: A Wednesday, 30 days before the next month's third Friday.

vertical.label: Vertical
vertical.about: Two options of one right, one sold and one bought further out.

butterfly.label: Butterfly
butterfly.about: Long: two sold at the body, one bought each side, the wings equal.

broken_wing.label: Broken-wing butterfly
broken_wing.about: Long: a butterfly with the far wing wider.

ratio.label: Ratio spread
ratio.about: One bought, more sold further out.

straddle.label: Straddle
straddle.about: A put and a call at the strike nearest the spot.

strangle.label: Strangle
strangle.about: A put below the spot and a call above.

iron_condor.label: Iron condor
iron_condor.about: A put spread and a call spread around the spot.

iron_fly.label: Iron fly
iron_fly.about: A put and a call at the spot, a wing bought each side.

jade_lizard.label: Jade lizard
jade_lizard.about: A sold put, and a call spread above the spot.

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.about: Sold on the near expiry, bought on a later one, at the same strike.

diagonal.label: Diagonal
diagonal.about: A calendar with the far leg bought further out.

covered.label: Covered call · Stock
covered.about: Shares with a call sold against them.

custom.label: Custom
custom.about: Any legs: starts from one, and you add the rest.

daily_time.label: Daily at a time
daily_time.about: Enters at the same minute each session the weekdays allow.

near_close.label: Near the close
near_close.about: Enters a few minutes before the close, on the day's settled move.

rsi_pullback.label: Pullback in an uptrend
rsi_pullback.about: A short-term oversold close while the longer trend is up: the day the 2-day RSI drops under 10 above the 200-day average, read on today's bar in the minutes before the close.

down_days.label: Down days in an uptrend
down_days.about: Several down closes in a row while the close is above its long average.

rsi_overbought.label: Overbought in a downtrend
rsi_overbought.about: A short-term overbought close while the longer trend is down: the mirror of the pullback.

ma_cross.label: Moving-average cross
ma_cross.about: A fast average crossing a slow one on intraday bars, inside a window.
ma_cross.suits: spreads on the side of the cross

orb.label: Opening-range breakout
orb.about: The price leaving the first minutes' range, once, no later than a set time.
orb.suits: spreads on the side of the break

gap_fill.label: Gap fill
gap_fill.about: An opening gap of at least a set size closing back to the prior close.

after_event.label: After an event
after_event.about: A set number of sessions after a calendar event, at a set time: the volatility after it.

custom.label: Custom
custom.about: A fixed time to start from: any entry kind, signal and gates from here.

vix_band.label: VIX within a band
vix_band.about: VIX now between two levels: not too quiet, not a panic.

iv_rank.label: Implied vol rank elevated
iv_rank.about: The underlying's vol index ranked high against its own last year.

iv_over_rv.label: Implied over realized
iv_over_rv.about: Options price more movement than the underlying has shown lately.

calm_open.label: Calm open
calm_open.about: A small opening gap and VIX not jumping.

quiet_day.label: Quiet so far today
quiet_day.about: The price near the prior close at the entry.

uptrend.label: In an uptrend
uptrend.about: The price above its long simple average.

time.label: At a time
time.about: Enters at the same minute each session the weekdays allow.

more.window: for up to {window} minutes after it

orb.label: Opening-range break
orb.about: Enters when the price leaves the range of the session's first minutes.
orb.sentence: Enter when the price breaks {direction} the first {minutes} minutes' range, no later than {latest} ET

single_shot.true: only on the minute of the break
single_shot.false: on any minute after the break, until it enters

trigger.label: On a trigger
trigger.about: Enters when a signal fires inside a window, or at a fixed time.

at.label: At a fixed time
at.about: Enters at one minute, or the first minute it can within a few after.

signal.label: When a signal fires
signal.about: Enters on the signal's first firing between two times.

within.null: any time before the window closes

daily.true: on daily bars, from the session before

developing.true: on today's daily bar as it stands, read each minute

confirm.label: Confirm
confirm.sentence: held for {confirm} bars in a row

reset.label: Reset
reset.sentence: re-arming only after it moves back {reset} past the level

cross.label: Crosses
cross.about: One indicator crossing above or below another, or a number.

range.label: Enters or leaves a band
range.about: An indicator moving into, or out of, a band between two numbers.

trend.label: Rising or falling
trend.about: An indicator higher (or lower) on each of its last few bars.

consecutive.label: Closes in a row
consecutive.about: A run of bars that each close up, or each close down.
consecutive.sentence: the price closes {direction} {n} bars in a row

gap.label: Opening gap
gap.about: The session opening away from the previous close.

gap_fill.label: Gap fills
gap_fill.about: The price coming back across an opening gap toward the previous close.
gap_fill.sentence: an opening gap of at least {min_pct}% fills

change.label: Moves from the open or the close
change.about: The price up or down a set percent since the open or the previous close.

change_from.label: Moves from a price
change_from.about: The price a set percent past a fixed level.

opening_range.label: Breaks the opening range
opening_range.about: The price leaving the range of the session's first minutes.
opening_range.sentence: the price breaks {side} the first {minutes} minutes' range

prior_session.label: Breaks yesterday's high or low
prior_session.about: The price passing the previous session's high or low.
prior_session.sentence: the price breaks the previous session's {side}

new_extreme.label: New high or low
new_extreme.about: The price making a new high or low over a lookback.
new_extreme.sentence: the price makes a new {side} over {lookback} bars

distance.label: Near or far from a high or low
distance.about: The price within, or beyond, a percent of a recent high or low.

level_break.label: Breaks a swing level
level_break.about: The close beyond the latest confirmed swing high or swing low.
level_break.sentence: the close breaks the latest {side} swing, confirmed {k} bars either side

trendline_break.label: Breaks a trendline
trendline_break.about: The close beyond the line through the latest two swing highs or lows.
trendline_break.sentence: the close breaks the {side} trendline, swings confirmed {k} bars either side

consolidation_break.label: Breaks out of a tight range
consolidation_break.about: A close outside a run of bars that stayed within a narrow band.
consolidation_break.sentence: the price closes {side} {n} bars that spanned at most {max_pct}%

event.label: Around a calendar event
event.about: A set number of days before, on or after a scheduled event.

candle.label: Candle pattern
candle.about: One bar's shape, such as a hammer or an engulfing bar.

vwap_band.label: VWAP band
vwap_band.sentence: the VWAP's {side} band {k} deviations out, from {anchor}

relative_volume.label: Relative volume
relative_volume.sentence: volume against the same minute over {n} sessions

change_pct.label: Move today
change_pct.about: The price's change since the previous close, in percent.

sd_change.label: Move today in standard deviations
sd_change.about: Today's move against the day's expected move from VIX.

gap_pct.label: Opening gap
gap_pct.about: The open against the previous close, in percent.

above_ma.label: Above a moving average
above_ma.about: The price above its average of the daily closes before today.

rsi.label: RSI
rsi.about: The relative strength index on intraday bars, 0 to 100.

stoch.label: Stochastic
stoch.about: The stochastic's %K on intraday bars, 0 to 100.

vix_change_pct.label: VIX change today
vix_change_pct.about: VIX's change since its previous close, in percent.

vol_index_rank.label: Implied vol rank
vol_index_rank.about: The underlying's vol index ranked between its low and high over a lookback, 0 to 100.

vol_index_percentile.label: Implied vol percentile
vol_index_percentile.about: The share of past sessions the vol index closed below today's, 0 to 100.

vol_index_minus_rv.label: Implied over realized vol
vol_index_minus_rv.about: The vol index less the underlying's realized vol, in vol points.
vol_index_minus_rv.sentence: implied vol less realized is {range} points

expected_move_pct.label: Expected move
expected_move_pct.about: The at-the-money straddle on the trade's expiry, in percent of the price.

gex_ratio.label: Dealer gamma balance
gex_ratio.about: Calls' against puts' gamma exposure over strikes near the price.
gex_ratio.sentence: the gamma ratio over the {strikes} strikes {mode} the price is {range}

gex_put_total.label: Put gamma total
gex_put_total.about: The summed put gamma exposure over strikes near the price, in dollars.
gex_put_total.sentence: put gamma over the {strikes} strikes {mode} the price is {range}

gex_max_otm.label: Largest gamma strike's distance
gex_max_otm.about: How far out of the money the largest-gamma strike near the price sits.
gex_max_otm.sentence: the largest-gamma strike of the {strikes} nearest is at most {max}% out on the {side} side

no_position_today.label: Another automation is idle
no_position_today.about: Another automation has neither entered today nor holds anything open.
no_position_today.sentence: {arm} has not entered today and holds nothing

mid_price.label: Price of the trade
mid_price.about: The structure's price at the mid, per share.

bid_ask.label: Bid-ask width
bid_ask.about: The structure's whole bid-ask width, per share.
bid_ask.sentence: the bid-ask is at most ${max} wide

reward_risk.label: Reward to risk
reward_risk.about: The most it can make over the most it can lose, at the mid.
reward_risk.sentence: the reward is at least {min}% of the risk

profit_target_pct.label: Take profit
profit_target_pct.about: Close once the trade has made this share of the most it can make.
profit_target_pct.sentence: Take profit at {profit_target_pct}% of the most it can make

profit_dollars.label: Take profit in dollars
profit_dollars.about: Close once the open P&L reaches a dollar amount.

trailing_stop.label: Trailing stop
trailing_stop.about: Once the trade is up, close if it gives back a set amount from its best.

more.trailing_stop.pct: or trail by {trailing_stop.pct}% of the most it can make

stop_credit_multiple.label: Stop loss, credit trades
stop_credit_multiple.about: Close a credit trade once its loss reaches a multiple of the credit.
stop_credit_multiple.sentence: Stop at a loss of {stop_credit_multiple}× the credit

stop_debit_pct.label: Stop loss, debit trades
stop_debit_pct.about: Close a debit trade once it has lost this share of the debit.
stop_debit_pct.sentence: Stop at a loss of {stop_debit_pct}% of the debit

stop_dollars.label: Stop loss in dollars
stop_dollars.about: Close once the open loss reaches a dollar amount.

touch.label: Price touches a level
touch.about: Close when the price moves a set distance from where it entered.
touch.sentence: Close if the price moves {touch.points} points from the entry

delta_limit.label: Delta limit
delta_limit.about: Close once the structure's delta per unit passes a size, either way.
delta_limit.sentence: Close once its delta passes {delta_limit} either way

signal.label: On a signal
signal.about: Close when a signal fires on the underlying, read as an entry's is.

close_at_dte.label: Days left
close_at_dte.about: Close once this many calendar days are left to expiry.

close_before_expiry_min.label: Before the expiry's close
close_before_expiry_min.about: Close this many minutes before the near expiry's close.

avoid_events.label: Before an event
avoid_events.about: Close the session before a listed event, a set time before the close.
avoid_events.sentence: Close {avoid_events.before_close_min} minutes before the close ahead of {avoid_events.labels}

max_spread.label: Wide quotes
max_spread.about: Hold off any exit while the structure's quotes are wider than this.
max_spread.sentence: Wait out quotes wider than ${max_spread} a share

delta.label: Delta
delta.about: The strike whose delta is nearest a target: 0.16 is about a 1 in 6 chance of finishing in the money.

premium.label: Premium
premium.about: The strike whose option is priced nearest a dollar amount a share.

spot.label: From the price
spot.about: A strike a set distance from the underlying's price now.

prev_close.label: From the previous close
prev_close.about: A strike a set distance from the previous session's close.

open.label: From the open
open.about: A strike a set distance from the session's open.

expected_move.label: Expected moves
expected_move.about: A strike a number of expected moves (the at-the-money straddle) from the price.

std_dev.label: Standard deviations
std_dev.about: A strike a number of standard deviations from the price, read off the straddle.

opening_range.label: From the opening range
opening_range.about: A strike at the opening range's high, low or midpoint, once the range has closed.

entry_level.label: From the entry's price
entry_level.about: A strike a set distance from the price when the entry fired.

from_leg.label: From another leg
from_leg.about: A strike a set distance from a leg placed before it, as a spread's wing is.

same_as.label: Same as another leg
same_as.about: The same strike as a leg placed before it.

match_width.label: Match another spread's width
match_width.about: From one leg by the width between two others, so both sides match.

max_abs_gex.label: Largest gamma strike
max_abs_gex.about: The strike with the largest gamma exposure near the price.
max_abs_gex.sentence: at the largest-gamma strike of the {strikes} nearest

gex_max.label: Largest of a gamma measure
gex_max.about: The strike that is largest on one gamma or open-interest measure near the price.
gex_max.sentence: at the largest {measure} strike of the {strikes} nearest

price.above: the first listed at or above
price.below: the first listed at or below

between.label: Between
between.about: A listed expiry inside a range of calendar days out.
between.sentence: Expiring between {min} and {max} days out, the {prefer}

at_least.label: At least
at_least.about: The nearest listed expiry at least so many calendar days out.

dte.label: Exactly
dte.about: The listed expiry a set number of calendar days out.

calendar.label: Exactly, calendar days
calendar.about: The listed expiry a set number of calendar days out.

market_days.label: Exactly, trading days
market_days.about: The listed expiry a set number of trading days out (0 is today's).

after_near.label: After the near expiry
after_near.about: The first listed expiry at least so many days after the near one.
after_near.sentence: The far leg expires at least {days} days after the near one

contracts.label: Contracts
contracts.about: The same number of contracts every time.

max_risk.label: Risk budget
max_risk.about: The most contracts whose most-it-can-lose fits a dollar amount.
max_risk.sentence: Trade as many as fit ${max_risk} of risk

allocation_pct.label: Share of an allocation
allocation_pct.about: The most contracts whose risk fits a percent of the money set aside.
allocation_pct.sentence: Trade as many as fit {allocation_pct}% of ${allocation}

progression.label: Step after a run
progression.about: After each loss (or win) in a row, change the count, held between a floor and a ceiling.
progression.sentence: after each {after} in a row, {step} contracts, between {floor} and {ceiling}

vertical.sentence: {direction} a {right} spread on {symbol}, the short strike at {target} {place_by} and the other {width} points further out

ratio.sentence: Buy a {right} on {symbol} at {target} {place_by} and sell {ratio} more {width} points further out

butterfly.sentence: {direction} a {right} butterfly on {symbol}, the body at {target} {place_by} and wings {width} points wide

broken_wing.sentence: {direction} a broken-wing {right} butterfly on {symbol}, the body at {target} {place_by}, wings {width} and {width2} points wide

straddle.sentence: {direction} a straddle on {symbol} at the strike nearest the price

strangle.sentence: {direction} a strangle on {symbol} with both strikes at {target} {place_by}

iron_condor.sentence: {direction} an iron condor on {symbol} with short strikes at {target} {place_by} and wings {width} points wide

iron_fly.sentence: {direction} an iron fly on {symbol} at the price, wings {width} points wide

jade_lizard.sentence: Sell a jade lizard on {symbol}: a put at {target} {place_by} and a call spread {width} points wide

diagonal.sentence: Buy a {right} diagonal on {symbol} at {target} {place_by}, the far leg {width} points further out

covered.sentence: Hold shares of {symbol} and sell a call against them
